recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. If a future work group wants literal wire codes PINF/NINF instead of negative-infinity/positive-infinity with NINF/PINF display aliases, handle that as a new THO/terminology policy issue rather than a missing application of FHIR-10556.
issue_request: FHIR-10556 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification OO change request asking to add DataAbsentReason options for device-reported special numeric values. The applied scope was PINF/NINF support; OTH/ascomp from the original description were not the final applied core change.
initial_application: Historical application happened in a113c29c06d93deff51d451695059344be601be5, which added v3 NullFlavor NINF/PINF to Observation value absent reason, and df58b619135a2e170435e0af16e61b82b2280152, svn revision 13066, which added ninf/pinf rows to the FHIR data-absent-reason terminology content.
additional_context: FHIR-13547 recorded Vocabulary concern about raw v3 NINF/PINF DataAbsentReason codes. FHIR-15567 later published the refined representation: not-a-number, negative-infinity, and positive-infinity under error, with NINF/PINF retained in displays and mappings. Core CodeSystem terminology content later moved to THO/UTG; current core retains the DataAbsentReason ValueSet wrapper and Observation bindings.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Current source/terminologies/valueset-data-absent-reason.xml includes all codes from http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/data-absent-reason, and Observation.dataAbsentReason plus Observation.component.dataAbsentReason bind to that ValueSet. THO includes negative-infinity and positive-infinity with NINF/PINF displays, so adding literal PINF/NINF codes in core would conflict with later applied decisions.

related_jiras.note: Vocab reviewed the raw NINF/PINF addition and advised against treating the v3 NullFlavor codes themselves as DataAbsentReason codes.
Published follow-up that normalized the floating point error codes to not-a-number, negative-infinity, and positive-infinity under error while keeping NINF/PINF as display/mapping context.
Co-applied in svn revision 13066 for DataAbsentReason not-applicable, explaining why the FHIR-10556 implementation commit touched the same terminology worksheet.
